relaxed.title: Relaxed
relaxed.body: The general meaning of the answer is acceptable as correct. Rephrasing and typos are also accepted.

moderate.title: Moderate
moderate.body: Exact match required, but misspellings are accepted (e.g. accent marks, missing letters).

strict.title: Strict
strict.body: Exact match required. Only small stylistic mistakes are accepted (case, punctuation, or text in parentheses).
